title: Reopening Schools in a Pandemic with Heidi Schweingruber, PhD

sentences.en: As coronavirus cases continue to surge across the United States, parents, teachers, and school officials are looking warily toward the beginning of the 2020 school year.
sentences.zh: 随着新冠疫情在美国各地持续蔓延，家长、教师和学校官员都在忧心忡忡地展望 2020 学年的开学。

sentences.en: With many openings just a few weeks away, will children return to physical classrooms?
sentences.zh: 距离许多学校开学仅剩几周时间，孩子们会回到实体教室吗？

sentences.en: Or will they log into classes via
sentences.zh: 还是他们会通过

sentences.en: Zoom?
sentences.zh: Zoom 登录上课？

sentences.en: Or will it be some combination of both?
sentences.zh: 又或者是两者的某种结合？

sentences.en: These questions have touched off emotional debates among parents, health officials, school systems, teachers, unions, and other groups.
sentences.zh: 这些问题在家长、卫生官员、学校系统、教师、工会和其他群体之间引发了激烈的争论。

sentences.en: It's become a political flashpoint, too.
sentences.zh: 这也成了一个政治焦点。

sentences.en: President Trump has threatened to withhold funding from schools that choose not to bring kids back to classrooms, even as major school systems across the country are
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统威胁要扣留那些选择不让孩子回到教室上课的学校的资金，尽管全国各地的主要学校系统都在

sentences.en: announcing plans to start the school year online.
sentences.zh: 宣布在线开启新学年的计划。

sentences.en: Schools must weigh the health risks of reopening buildings against the educational risks of keeping them closed.
sentences.zh: 学校必须权衡重新开放校舍的健康风险与保持关闭带来的教育风险。

sentences.en: Psychological research can offer tools to help schools minimize harm and make the best decisions possible under these difficult circumstances.
sentences.zh: 心理学研究可以提供工具，帮助学校在这些困难情况下尽量减少伤害并做出最佳决策。

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学谈话》，这是美国心理学会的旗舰播客，

sentences.en: Association that explores the connections between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 旨在探索心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim
sentences.zh: 我是金·

sentences.en: Mills.
sentences.zh: 米尔斯。

sentences.en: Our guest today is Dr. Heidi Schweingruber, a developmental psychologist and director of the
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾是发展心理学家、美国国家科学院科学教育委员会主任海蒂·施温格鲁伯博士。

sentences.en: National Academy of Sciences Board on Science Education.
sentences.zh: 国家科学院科学教育委员会。

sentences.en: She and her colleagues released a report
sentences.zh: 她和同事在 7 月 15 日发布了一份报告，

sentences.en: July 15th, offering guidance on how K-12 schools can weigh the risks and benefits of reopening.
sentences.zh: 为 K-12 学校如何权衡重新开放的风险与收益提供了指导。

sentences.en: They gathered research from epidemiologists, social and behavioral scientists, and experts in public health and education.
sentences.zh: 他们收集了来自流行病学家、社会和行为科学家以及公共卫生和教育领域专家的研究成果。

sentences.en: Their conclusion was that schools should prioritize reopening for students in grades K-5 and those with special needs.
sentences.zh: 他们的结论是，学校应优先考虑让 K-5 年级的学生和有特殊需求的学生返校。

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, Dr. Schweingruber.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《心理学谈话》，施温格鲁伯博士。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: So as I just said, the top-line conclusion you came to in the report is that schools should prioritize reopening for the youngest students, K-5, and those with special needs.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才所说，你们在报告中得出的首要结论是，学校应优先考虑让低年级学生（K-5）和有特殊需求的学生返校。

sentences.en: How did you come to that conclusion and what evidence did you base that conclusion on?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何得出这一结论的？这一结论基于什么证据？

sentences.en: So the committee recognized that fundamentally, the decision to reopen is a very complex one that involves weighing risks.
sentences.zh: 委员会认识到，从根本上讲，重新开放的决定非常复杂，涉及风险权衡。

sentences.en: And the primary sets of risks are the public health risks from the virus and
sentences.zh: 主要的风险是来自病毒和接触病毒的公共卫生风险，

sentences.en: exposure to the virus against the educational risks and the risks to families and communities of keeping school buildings closed.
sentences.zh: 以及保持校舍关闭对教育、家庭和社区造成的风险。

sentences.en: And the committee actually was very careful to say school buildings closed because they, we made the assumption that as schools did in spring 2020, they provided virtual and
sentences.zh: 委员会非常谨慎地使用了“校舍关闭”这一说法，因为我们假设，正如 2020 年春季学校所做的那样，他们提供了虚拟和

sentences.en: distance learning options that the same will happen in the coming school year if schools don't open for in-person learning.
sentences.zh: 远程学习选项，如果学校不开放线下教学，新学年也会发生同样的情况。

sentences.en: So essentially the risks were public health risks against the educational risks if kids aren't getting in-person instruction and if families can't benefit from the services that
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，风险权衡在于：如果孩子们无法获得面对面教学，如果家庭无法从学校提供的面对面服务中受益，那么公共卫生风险与教育风险孰轻孰重。

sentences.en: schools give in person.
sentences.zh: （学校提供的面对面服务）

sentences.en: So then the question was, if kids are going to be experiencing distance learning rather than in person, which kids benefit most or least from distance learning?
sentences.zh: 那么问题就变成了，如果孩子们要进行远程学习而不是面对面学习，哪些孩子从远程学习中获益最多或最少？

sentences.en: So who is at greatest risk when you're seeing distance learning happen over a long period of time?
sentences.zh: 那么，当远程学习长期持续时，谁面临的风险最大？

sentences.en: So that required really turning to the developmental psychology literature and what we know about kids of different
sentences.zh: 这确实需要转向发展心理学文献，以及我们对不同年龄段儿童的了解，

sentences.en: ages and how they learn and the kinds of supports that they need.
sentences.zh: 了解他们如何学习以及他们需要什么样的支持。

sentences.en: So the committee looked at broadly what we know about development and what we know about academic development, cognitive development,
sentences.zh: 因此，委员会广泛审视了我们对不同年龄段儿童的发展、学术发展、认知发展以及社会情感发展的了解，

sentences.en: as well as socio-emotional development for kids of different ages, and what we know about modes of
sentences.zh: 以及我们对远程学习模式的了解，

sentences.en: distance learning and particularly virtual learning because we assume that's a lot of what schools are going to rely on.
sentences.zh: 特别是虚拟学习，因为我们假设学校很大程度上将依赖这种方式。

sentences.en: And so one of the primary things that the committee looked at was who can benefit
sentences.zh: 委员会研究的主要问题之一是，谁能从远程学习中获益最多，

sentences.en: most from distance learning and who might actually be at the largest disadvantage in the situation of distance learning.
sentences.zh: 而在远程学习的情况下，谁可能处于最大的劣势。

sentences.en: Now leaving aside things we know about problems of access, like broadband access and things like that, but just looking developmentally at the question.
sentences.zh: 抛开我们所知的接入问题（如宽带接入等），仅从发展角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: The committee weighed the ways that students can engage in virtual learning as it relates to their development.
sentences.zh: 委员会权衡了学生参与虚拟学习的方式与其发展之间的关系。

sentences.en: So young children in particular are still in the process of developing self-regulation, executive function, all the things that allow you to monitor and check on your own learning.
sentences.zh: 特别是年幼的孩子，他们仍处于发展自我调节、执行功能以及所有允许你监控和检查自己学习情况的能力的过程中。

sentences.en: Maintaining attention, diverting your attention back if you get distracted, things like that.
sentences.zh: 保持注意力、在分心时将注意力拉回，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Young children are less able to do that than older children.
sentences.zh: 年幼的孩子比大孩子更难做到这一点。

sentences.en: On the whole, certainly there's wide individual differences.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，当然存在广泛的个体差异。

sentences.en: And we talked with Barbara Means, who's at Digital
sentences.zh: 我们与 Digital Promise 的芭芭拉·米恩斯进行了交谈，她曾对教育技术进行过研究。

sentences.en: Promise, who's done research on education technology.
sentences.zh: Promise，她曾从事教育技术方面的研究。

sentences.en: And she emphasized that particularly for younger children, most often because of those developmental issues, they do better in virtual settings with adult supervision.
sentences.zh: 她强调，特别是对于年幼的孩子，由于上述发展问题，他们在有成人监督的情况下，在虚拟环境中的表现会更好。

sentences.en: Because an adult can help guide their engagement with the technology.
sentences.zh: 因为成年人可以帮助引导他们使用技术。

sentences.en: They can redirect them if they lose attention.
sentences.zh: 如果他们注意力不集中，成年人可以引导他们。

sentences.en: And they can help them do the kinds of things like asking themselves questions about whether they really understood what just happened.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以帮助他们做一些事情，比如问自己是否真的理解了刚才发生的事情。

sentences.en: So is that somebody at home with them?
sentences.zh: 所以是指家里有人陪着他们吗？

sentences.en: That's not the teacher necessarily, but it's a parent who's guiding.
sentences.zh: 不一定是老师，而是引导他们的家长。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you're using technology in a classroom, it's a teacher, usually, or a teacher's aide.
sentences.zh: 如果你在教室里使用技术，通常是老师或助教。

sentences.en: If you're home, it's somebody older than the child.
sentences.zh: 如果你在家，那就是比孩子年长的人。

sentences.en: Maybe that's a parent or guardian.
sentences.zh: 可能是家长或监护人。

sentences.en: Maybe in some cases it's an older sib, but it's someone who can help redirect them.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下可能是年长的兄弟姐妹，但必须是能帮助引导他们的人。

sentences.en: And so the thinking was that young children in particular may be at risk if they're having extended distance learning, because it's just harder for them to
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的想法是，年幼的孩子如果进行长时间的远程学习，可能会面临风险，因为他们很难

sentences.en: engage in a serious way over a long period of time with that medium.
sentences.zh: 通过这种媒介长期保持专注。

sentences.en: And given that we know lots of families are going to have caregivers who have to leave the home.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道许多家庭的照护者必须离家工作。

sentences.en: There may not be older children or older children may need to do their own virtual learning.
sentences.zh: 可能没有年长的孩子，或者年长的孩子也需要进行自己的虚拟学习。

sentences.en: We can't assume that all young children are going to have that support.
sentences.zh: 我们不能假设所有年幼的孩子都能得到这种支持。

sentences.en: And so there was a real worry about that.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是一个令人担忧的问题。

sentences.en: On top of that, there is well-established evidence that for kids in kindergarten through third grade, particularly in reading,
sentences.zh: 此外，有充分的证据表明，对于幼儿园到三年级的孩子，特别是在阅读方面，

sentences.en: but also in mathematics, if you have delays in those early grades, and for example, you don't get
sentences.zh: 在数学方面也是如此，如果你在这些低年级出现延迟，例如，你没有达到一定的阅读水平，

sentences.en: to a certain level in your reading proficiency, it can have long-term consequences for your academic success.
sentences.zh: 这可能会对你的学业成功产生长期影响。

sentences.en: So that the turn of phrase is that up to third grade, you learn to read.
sentences.zh: 所以有一句名言是：三年级之前，你是在学习阅读。

sentences.en: After third grade, you read to learn.
sentences.zh: 三年级之后，你是在通过阅读来学习。

sentences.en: And so that if you haven't developed some sort of proficiency in reading, by then, you tend to get farther and farther behind.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在那之前没有培养出某种阅读能力，你往往会越来越落后。

sentences.en: And that sort of lack of reading ability early on has actually been linked to dropout rates and things like that.
sentences.zh: 这种早期的阅读能力缺乏实际上与辍学率等问题有关。

sentences.en: So there was some real concern that one, these younger kids might not benefit from the distance learning as much.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实非常担心，第一，这些年幼的孩子可能无法从远程学习中获得同样多的收益。

sentences.en: They might need adult supervision or supervision from someone older than them that isn't available.
sentences.zh: 他们可能需要成人或比他们年长的人的监督，而这种监督可能无法提供。

sentences.en: And that the consequences for them would be bigger in terms of the long-term academic outcomes.
sentences.zh: 而且从长期的学业成果来看，这对他们造成的后果会更大。

sentences.en: And finally, the committee then also looked at the evidence on who's most impacted, which
sentences.zh: 最后，委员会还研究了关于谁受影响最大的证据，

sentences.en: of those young children are likely to have the biggest long-term sort of negative consequences.
sentences.zh: 即哪些年幼的孩子最可能产生最大的长期负面后果。

sentences.en: And there an equity issue emerged where it's pretty clear we already have some socioeconomic
sentences.zh: 这里出现了一个公平问题，很明显，孩子们在入学时就已经存在一些社会经济差异，

sentences.en: differences between kids when they enter school with wealthier children typically coming in already with some reading skill.
sentences.zh: 富裕家庭的孩子通常在入学时就已经具备了一些阅读技能。

sentences.en: Schools sometimes can close that, but there was particular concern that for low-income children, they might be sort of get a double hit in the very young children where if they
sentences.zh: 学校有时可以缩小这种差距，但特别令人担忧的是，对于低收入家庭的孩子，年幼的他们可能会受到双重打击，如果他们

sentences.en: didn't have access to the distance learning to the same level, and then they didn't have the adult
sentences.zh: 无法获得同等水平的远程学习，又缺乏成人的支持，

sentences.en: support, and then we already know there's some lags that you were going to really create a big equity issue.
sentences.zh: 而且我们已经知道存在一些滞后，这真的会造成巨大的公平问题。

sentences.en: So what happens around sixth grade where kids are able to engage in distance learning in an effective way?
sentences.zh: 那么六年级左右的情况如何？孩子们是否能够有效地进行远程学习？

sentences.en: What's going on in their brains that makes it more feasible starting at that age?
sentences.zh: 他们的大脑发生了什么变化，使得从那个年龄开始变得更可行？

sentences.en: Well, they're actually over time, and certainly I want to emphasize again, there are...
sentences.zh: 嗯，随着时间的推移，我还是要再次强调，有……

sentences.en: It's not every kid, but...
sentences.zh: 并不是每个孩子都这样，但是……

sentences.en: Right, not every kid.
sentences.zh: 对，不是每个孩子。

sentences.en: But in general, as you move into middle school and especially into high school, kids are developing what we call executive function, the ability to monitor their own learning,
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，随着进入初中，特别是高中，孩子们正在发展我们所说的执行功能，即监控自己学习的能力，

sentences.en: the ability to regulate their own behavior and regulate attention.
sentences.zh: 调节自己行为和注意力的能力。

sentences.en: So it's what we might call metacognition, the ability to kind of look at your own state of knowledge, to understand your memory
sentences.zh: 所以这可以称为元认知，即审视自己知识状态的能力，了解自己记忆的局限性，

sentences.en: limitations, to know when your attention is drifting and have strategies for bringing it back.
sentences.zh: 知道自己的注意力何时分散，并有策略地将其拉回。

sentences.en: And that develops over time.
sentences.zh: 这是随着时间推移而发展的。

sentences.en: And starting in middle school and into high school, kids are getting better at that.
sentences.zh: 从初中到高中，孩子们在这方面做得越来越好。

sentences.en: Certainly, they still have a ways to go.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: Those of us who know middle schoolers and high schoolers know they're not all great at it, but they're certainly getting better.
sentences.zh: 我们这些了解初中生和高中生的人都知道，他们并不都擅长这一点，但他们确实在进步。

sentences.en: And you see a big difference between, say, a seven-year-old and a 13-year-old in the ability to do those things.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到七岁和十三岁的孩子在做这些事情的能力上有很大的不同。

sentences.en: So you mentioned a minute ago about disparities, what happens to children who come from families that don't have the resources to manage their education at home and those who do.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了差异，那么对于那些家庭没有资源管理其在家教育的孩子，以及那些有资源的孩子，会发生什么？

sentences.en: So schools are forced into remote learning.
sentences.zh: 学校被迫进行远程学习。

sentences.en: What can they do to address these equity issues?
sentences.zh: 他们能做些什么来解决这些公平问题？

sentences.en: Some of it is purely access, which doesn't go into really the details of learning at all, but it is
sentences.zh: 其中一些纯粹是接入问题，这根本不涉及学习细节，但它纯粹是着眼于……

sentences.en: purely looking at, and schools did a lot of this in spring 2020 with the big closures, providing devices if you knew that kids didn't have them at home, providing.
sentences.zh: 学校在 2020 年春季的大规模关闭期间做了很多工作，如果知道孩子家里没有设备，就提供设备，提供……

sentences.en: In some places,
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，

sentences.en: school systems knew that there wasn't good broadband access, and they might have done packets, right, instead of online.
sentences.zh: 学校系统知道宽带接入不好，他们可能会提供学习包，而不是在线学习。

sentences.en: Some did mobile hotspots.
sentences.zh: 有些学校提供了移动热点。

sentences.en: You know, we read about, I'm sure people have read about buses where they put, you know, hotspots on the bus and drove them around, or people driving to
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们读到过，我相信人们也读到过关于校车的报道，他们在校车上安装了热点，然后开着车到处跑，或者人们开车去

sentences.en: parking lots next to a library where they would have, none of that is ideal, but providing good access is one of them.
sentences.zh: 图书馆旁边的停车场，虽然这些都不理想，但提供良好的接入是其中之一。

sentences.en: Then there are other things about how you structure the learning, and we didn't go as much into this in the report.
sentences.zh: 然后还有关于如何构建学习的其他事情，我们在报告中没有深入探讨这一点。

sentences.en: We weren't asked these educational questions, but we did refer, there's a nice discussion of this that the Education Trust and Digital Promise put together,
sentences.zh: 我们没有被问及这些教育问题，但我们确实提到了，教育信托基金（Education Trust）和 Digital Promise 对此进行了很好的讨论，

sentences.en: sort of questions to look at, and examples of how to provide more equitable digital learning.
sentences.zh: 整理了一些需要关注的问题，以及如何提供更公平的数字学习的例子。

sentences.en: And some of those things are, for example, not assuming that all kids can do what would be called
sentences.zh: 其中一些例子是，不要假设所有孩子都能进行所谓的

sentences.en: synchronous learning, where the teacher is engaging in discussion or delivering instructions, and you
sentences.zh: 同步学习，即老师参与讨论或传达指令，

sentences.en: expect all students to be there at a certain time, but to allow for some asynchronous as well,
sentences.zh: 并期望所有学生在特定时间都在场，而是要允许一些异步学习，

sentences.en: so that you can adjust to family schedules, so that if a parent has to be, or a guardian has to be out
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以适应家庭的时间表，如果家长或监护人必须在特定时间外出，

sentences.en: of a house at a certain time, you might then allow asynchronous, so that in the evening when there is
sentences.zh: 你可能允许异步学习，这样在晚上有成年人在家时，

sentences.en: an adult, that might be when they can carve out the time to do sort of the dedicated virtual learning.
sentences.zh: 那可能就是他们可以抽出时间进行专门的虚拟学习的时候。

sentences.en: So, you know, allowing that kind of flexibility.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，允许这种灵活性。

sentences.en: Creating tasks that don't necessarily have to have an adult or an older sib around to do them.
sentences.zh: 创建不需要成年人或年长兄弟姐妹在场就能完成的任务。

sentences.en: So, thinking about, not assuming you're going to have the adult support in the background.
sentences.zh: 所以，要考虑到不要假设你会有成人的后台支持。

sentences.en: Those are just a few examples.
sentences.zh: 这些只是几个例子。

sentences.en: A lot of what children get from school, face-to-face school, of course, is meeting their social and emotional needs.
sentences.zh: 当然，孩子们从面对面学校获得的大部分东西是满足他们的社会和情感需求。

sentences.en: And some people think that children need to be in school just to be around other children, and that distance learning is just not good for their emotional and mental health.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为孩子们需要上学只是为了和其他孩子在一起，而远程学习对他们的情感和心理健康不利。

sentences.en: Your report didn't really get into that question.
sentences.zh: 你们的报告并没有真正深入探讨这个问题。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Did you consider it, but just not put it in the report?
sentences.zh: 你们考虑过，但没有写进报告吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And I will say that the committee did think about, even just in terms of learning, the fact that what we know from research on learning
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，委员会确实考虑过，即使只是从学习的角度来看，我们从学习研究中知道的事实是，

sentences.en: is that across all subject areas, the peer-to-peer learning is really important too.
sentences.zh: 在所有学科领域，同伴学习也非常重要。

sentences.en: And so that's definitely the case, and that's something you want to build in, even if you're trying to do, even if you're doing virtual.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是事实，即使你在尝试进行虚拟学习，这也是你想融入的东西。

sentences.en: The question of the sort of socio-emotional development and outcomes was a tricky one.
sentences.zh: 关于社会情感发展和结果的问题是一个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And the committee heard from some experts who talked about that.
sentences.zh: 委员会确实听取了一些专家的意见。

sentences.en: But what became difficult was to really look broadly at the literature and get a handle on whether school was the only place where that could definitely be provided.
sentences.zh: 但变得困难的是，真正广泛地审视文献，并弄清楚学校是否是唯一能提供这种支持的地方。

sentences.en: So the notion that there, it could be that you can support some of that social-emotional peer interaction through other community organizations and in families and neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 因此，可能通过其他社区组织、家庭和社区来支持部分社会情感同伴互动。

sentences.en: In addition, there's some important discussions in the literature on schools that indicate that schools aren't always a positive place for all kids all the time,
sentences.zh: 此外，关于学校的文献中也有一些重要的讨论，表明学校并不总是所有孩子在所有时间里的积极场所，

sentences.en: and that you do have some kids who have negative socio-emotional consequences from interactions in the school, like from bullying.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些孩子因为学校里的互动而产生负面的社会情感后果，比如欺凌。

sentences.en: Or for black children, there's some of the discipline practices in some settings can be harsh and can actually lead to interactions with the criminal justice system
sentences.zh: 或者对于黑人儿童，在某些环境下的纪律处分可能很严厉，实际上可能导致他们以比白人儿童更高的比率与刑事司法系统产生互动。

sentences.en: at a higher rate than white children.
sentences.zh: （比白人儿童）

sentences.en: So it was a very, very complicated issue to tease all of that and understand what are the broad socio-emotional consequences for not being in school buildings.
sentences.zh: 所以，梳理所有这些问题并理解不待在校舍里会产生什么样的广泛社会情感后果，是一个非常非常复杂的问题。

sentences.en: And can you make a strong argument that closing school buildings totally eliminates for all kids those positive socio-emotional opportunities?
sentences.zh: 你能有力地论证关闭校舍完全消除了所有孩子那些积极的社会情感机会吗？

sentences.en: And the committee, one, didn't have time to go into that nuance and wasn't sure that the argument was going to be as strong as it clearly was fairly
sentences.zh: 委员会一方面没有时间去深入探讨这种细微差别，也不确定这种论点是否像学术成果那样明确且有力。

sentences.en: strong for the academic outcomes.
sentences.zh: （学术成果）

sentences.en: The report makes some specific suggestions about what schools can do to mitigate health risks if they reopen, including providing face masks, enforcing physical distancing,
sentences.zh: 报告对学校重新开放时如何减轻健康风险提出了一些具体建议，包括提供口罩、强制保持身体距离、

sentences.en: and implementing new cleaning protocols.
sentences.zh: 以及实施新的清洁规程。

sentences.en: Which of these are the most important and are there other steps that schools can be taking?
sentences.zh: 其中哪些最重要？学校还可以采取哪些其他措施？

sentences.en: One of the real challenges for the committee was that we don't have a robust evidence base in schools that tells us specifically the differential effectiveness of these different
sentences.zh: 委员会面临的真正挑战之一是，我们没有关于学校的强有力的证据基础，能具体告诉我们这些不同策略的差异化有效性。

sentences.en: strategies.
sentences.zh: （策略）

sentences.en: But based on kind of first principles of transmission, given that the virus is transmitted by
sentences.zh: 但基于传播的基本原则，考虑到病毒是通过

sentences.en: droplet, respiratory droplets and aerosols, it's clear that masks for everyone where possible, teachers particularly, but really it's safest if everyone is wearing them.
sentences.zh: 飞沫、呼吸道飞沫和气溶胶传播的，很明显，在可能的情况下，每个人都应佩戴口罩，特别是老师，但如果每个人都佩戴，确实是最安全的。

sentences.en: The physical distancing that we've all heard about and we've all hopefully been practicing.
sentences.zh: 我们都听说过，并且希望我们一直在实践的身体距离。

sentences.en: And then eliminating large crowds and that just eliminates, it's easier to maintain physical distancing without those large crowds and it eliminates the
sentences.zh: 此外，消除大型集会也能消除风险，因为没有了大型集会，更容易保持社交距离，而且这消除了

sentences.en: number of opportunities for people to be infected in and large events of infection.
sentences.zh: 人们在大型感染事件中被感染的机会。

sentences.en: Those are key.
sentences.zh: 这些都是关键。

sentences.en: In addition, there's growing evidence and this was a real challenge to the committee because
sentences.zh: 此外，越来越多的证据表明——这对委员会来说是一个真正的挑战，因为

sentences.en: emerging discussion that some of these droplets can become aerosolized, meaning it's very, very tiny and suspended in air.
sentences.zh: 有新兴的讨论认为，其中一些飞沫可能会变成气溶胶，这意味着它们非常、非常微小，并悬浮在空气中。

sentences.en: And that evidence was emerging as the committee was doing its work, which is a big challenge.
sentences.zh: 当委员会开展工作时，这些证据才刚刚浮现，这是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: But it looks like there might be some mechanism there, which means that you do need to worry about ventilation and air filtration.
sentences.zh: 但看起来似乎存在某种机制，这意味着你确实需要关注通风和空气过滤问题。

sentences.en: So that opening doors, opening windows, making sure you have circulation, giving kids time to be outside.
sentences.zh: 所以要打开门窗，确保空气流通，让孩子们有时间待在户外。

sentences.en: In some places there's even been discussion of outdoor classrooms, which we didn't go into detail in the report because there's such varying climates in the
sentences.zh: 在一些地方，甚至有人讨论过户外课堂，但我们在报告中没有详细说明，因为美国的

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 气候差异很大，

sentences.en: and such varying possibility of even doing that.
sentences.zh: 而且实现这一点的可能性也各不相同。

sentences.en: But those are important also.
sentences.zh: 但这些也很重要。

sentences.en: A really promising strategy is something called cohorting or podding.
sentences.zh: 一个非常有前景的策略是所谓的“分组”或“豆荚式”教学。

sentences.en: Pods are what they're sometimes called where you have smaller groups of kids with a single teacher who move together during the day, eat in the room together.
sentences.zh: 有时也叫“豆荚”，即让一小群孩子由一位老师带领，白天在一起活动，并在教室内一起用餐。

sentences.en: And there are sort of two different pieces to that.
sentences.zh: 这其中包含两个不同的部分。

sentences.en: One is that it limits the number of different people they're all exposed to and limits the risk that way.
sentences.zh: 一是它限制了他们接触的不同人数，从而限制了风险。

sentences.en: It also means that if you do have someone in that pod getting
sentences.zh: 这也意味着，如果该小组中确实有人

sentences.en: sick, it limits the spread so that then you're not needing to sort of close down a whole building because you've limited to that pod, it's easier to do the sort of contact tracing.
sentences.zh: 生病了，它能限制传播，这样你就不需要关闭整栋大楼，因为你已经将其限制在那个小组内，进行接触者追踪也更容易。

sentences.en: And so that's another promising strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一个有前景的策略。

sentences.en: So you must have been well into the study, in fact, probably done by the time the study came out from
sentences.zh: 那么，当来自韩国的研究发布时，你们一定已经深入研究了，甚至可能已经完成了报告，

sentences.en: South Korea, finding that children younger than 10 transmit COVID to others much less often than adults do, but the risk is not zero.
sentences.zh: 该研究发现，10岁以下的儿童将新冠病毒传播给他人频率远低于成年人，但风险并非为零。

sentences.en: And that those from ages 10 to 19 spread the virus at least as well as adults do.
sentences.zh: 而10到19岁的青少年传播病毒的能力至少和成年人一样强。

sentences.en: You sort of magically hit that point by saying K through five, right?
sentences.zh: 你们通过说“幼儿园到五年级”神奇地触及了这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, you didn't have this information, but it just turns out you appear to be very prescient.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，虽然你们当时没有这些信息，但结果证明你们似乎非常有先见之明。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, we're very lucky.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们非常幸运。

sentences.en: No, that study came out afterwards, and I must say I was relieved that it didn't say, for example,
sentences.zh: 不，那项研究是后来才出来的，我必须说，我很欣慰它没有说，例如，

sentences.en: sixth graders, you know, six year olds are just as contagious as the older kids, for sure.
sentences.zh: 六年级学生，你知道，六岁的孩子和年龄较大的孩子一样具有传染性，这是肯定的。

sentences.en: There was also one that came out after our study, a study from Israel, where, if I remember right,
sentences.zh: 在我们研究之后还有一项研究，来自以色列，如果我没记错的话，

sentences.en: they were pointing particularly at the middle school students as being somewhat responsible for spread.
sentences.zh: 他们特别指出初中生在某种程度上要对传播负责。

sentences.en: And there it was a partly compliance with the protocols so that the younger children were more compliant.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上与对规程的遵守有关，年幼的孩子更遵守规程。

sentences.en: The older children maybe understood better why they should be doing it.
sentences.zh: 年龄较大的孩子可能更理解为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: And the middle schoolers were the ones who they had maybe less consistent following of the protocols.
sentences.zh: 而初中生可能对规程的执行不够一致。

sentences.en: Well, so this might be beyond the scope of the report, but some school districts are giving parents a choice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可能超出了报告的范围，但一些学区正在给家长选择权。

sentences.en: So where I live, for example, which is Fairfax County, Virginia, they've decided to let parents select between a two-day-a-week in-person hybrid learning model or full-time remote
sentences.zh: 比如我住的地方，弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县，他们决定让家长在每周两天面对面混合学习模式或全职远程

sentences.en: learning.
sentences.zh: 学习之间做出选择。

sentences.en: How should parents decide?
sentences.zh: 家长应该如何决定？

sentences.en: What should they take into consideration when they're looking at an option like this?
sentences.zh: 当他们考虑这样的选择时，应该考虑什么？

sentences.en: This is a really tough question, and it does go beyond the report.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棘手的问题，确实超出了报告的范围。

sentences.en: I'm willing to make some comments on it, but I have to stress this isn't in the report itself.
sentences.zh: 我愿意对此发表一些评论，但我必须强调，这并不在报告本身之中。

sentences.en: This is sort of a discussion of what you might consider.
sentences.zh: 这只是关于你可能需要考虑什么的讨论。

sentences.en: Okay, that's fair.
sentences.zh: 好的，这很公平。

sentences.en: Based on my judgment, yeah.
sentences.zh: 基于我的判断，是的。

sentences.en: One is your own child.
sentences.zh: 首先是你自己的孩子。

sentences.en: In many cases, you'll have had an experience with the virtual learning in spring 2020 or distance learning, and you can make some judgments about how well they did.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，你已经有了2020年春季虚拟学习或远程学习的经验，你可以对他们表现如何做出一些判断。

sentences.en: It's important to keep in mind that what happened in spring was not what any school system would plan.
sentences.zh: 重要的是要记住，春季发生的事情并不是任何学校系统会计划的。

sentences.en: They got no lead time for planning.
sentences.zh: 他们没有得到任何提前计划的时间。

sentences.en: They did not have a chance to put an infrastructure in place, nor do the professional development that you'd really want to do.
sentences.zh: 他们没有机会建立基础设施，也没有进行你真正想要做的专业发展。

sentences.en: So the distance and virtual learning in the coming year will probably be quite different,
sentences.zh: 所以未来一年的远程和虚拟学习可能会大不相同，

sentences.en: but you may have gotten a sense of how well your child did, and that might dictate how much you think your individual child could benefit from the face-to-face.
sentences.zh: 但你可能已经了解了你的孩子表现如何，这可能会决定你认为你的孩子能从面对面教学中获益多少。

sentences.en: The other thing I would do as a parent is ask, on those two days, what are the mitigation strategies you're using?
sentences.zh: 作为家长，我会做的另一件事是询问，在那两天里，你们正在使用什么缓解策略？

sentences.en: Are you going to be asking everyone where possible to wear masks?
sentences.zh: 你们会要求每个人在可能的情况下佩戴口罩吗？

sentences.en: How are you going to be implementing physical distancing?
sentences.zh: 你们打算如何实施物理距离？

sentences.en: What's the ventilation like?
sentences.zh: 通风情况如何？

sentences.en: So asking the questions about the key strategies.
sentences.zh: 所以要询问关于关键策略的问题。

sentences.en: And we actually, in Chapter 5 of our report, we kind of discuss them and lay them out, and there's actually a table,
sentences.zh: 实际上，在我们的报告第5章中，我们讨论并列出了这些策略，而且实际上有一个表格，

sentences.en: Table 5-1, that summarizes them.
sentences.zh: 表5-1，总结了这些内容。

sentences.en: And I might, as a parent, just look at that table and think, okay, what questions do I want to ask about what's going to happen on those two days if I'm choosing
sentences.zh: 如果我选择送孩子去学校，作为家长，我可能会看看那个表格，思考一下，如果我选择

sentences.en: to send my kids in person?
sentences.zh: 让孩子亲自去学校，关于那两天会发生什么，我想问什么问题？

sentences.en: The other thing is, there are some realities to different family situations, and it could be that both caregivers or one caregiver must work outside the home.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，不同的家庭情况存在一些现实问题，可能是两位看护人或其中一位看护人必须在户外工作。

sentences.en: And then there's another layer of thinking, which is how am I going to juggle this?
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一层思考，那就是我该如何兼顾这些？

sentences.en: Is it easier for me to juggle my work?
sentences.zh: 如果学生在学校待几天，我兼顾工作是否更容易？

sentences.en: And whatever, if the student is in the school for a couple of days, that's a reasonable factor to have to think about also.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这也是一个需要考虑的合理因素。

sentences.en: It's our reality right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在的现实。

sentences.en: So you had epidemiologists and public health experts on your panel, but you didn't come up with a set recommendation of area caseloads for when it's safe for schools to reopen.
sentences.zh: 所以你们的专家组里有流行病学家和公共卫生专家，但你们并没有就学校何时安全重开提出一套区域病例数的建议。

sentences.en: Why did you not address that?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们没有解决这个问题？

sentences.en: It's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: It was actually raised in some of the press coverage of the report after it came out.
sentences.zh: 实际上，在报告发布后的一些新闻报道中也提到了这一点。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons is that so many of the factors that need to be taken into account and understanding what threshold makes sense are very local.
sentences.zh: 原因之一是，在理解什么阈值是有意义时，需要考虑的许多因素都是非常本地化的。

sentences.en: For example, the strength of the healthcare infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 例如，医疗基础设施的实力。

sentences.en: How much bed space do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少床位空间？

sentences.en: How vulnerable is your population?
sentences.zh: 你的人口有多脆弱？

sentences.en: How many people do you know are working outside the home versus are going to be able to be teleworking and there won't be as much contact across the community?
sentences.zh: 你知道有多少人在户外工作，而不是能够远程办公，这样社区之间的接触就不会那么多？

sentences.en: And so there was a feeling that it was very difficult to set a single threshold that would really work across all communities.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们觉得很难设定一个真正适用于所有社区的单一阈值。

sentences.en: And communities might have different values and different willingness to take risk, either on the public health side or on the education side.
sentences.zh: 而且社区可能有不同的价值观和不同的风险承担意愿，无论是在公共卫生方面还是在教育方面。

sentences.en: And so the committee really thought there was a sense that you'd need the public health and epidemiology perspectives and science in the
sentences.zh: 因此，委员会确实认为，在对话中需要公共卫生和流行病学的观点与科学，

sentences.en: conversation, but considering at the same time, the values and the needs of the community.
sentences.zh: 但同时也要考虑社区的价值观和需求。

sentences.en: And so the committee just felt that it was very difficult to set a single threshold without being able to weigh those different aspects of individual communities.
sentences.zh: 所以委员会只是觉得，如果不权衡个体社区的这些不同方面，就很难设定一个单一的阈值。

sentences.en: That kind of speaks to the possibility that this might not be a one-time only decision.
sentences.zh: 这说明这可能不是一次性的决定。

sentences.en: So schools could reopen in one area and then decide that they have to close because of what's happening with their infection rate.
sentences.zh: 所以学校可以在一个地区重开，然后因为感染率的变化而决定必须关闭。

sentences.en: Who do you think should be involved in those closing and reopening decisions?
sentences.zh: 你认为谁应该参与这些关闭和重开的决定？

sentences.en: And how can schools and communities prepare for that?
sentences.zh: 学校和社区该如何为此做好准备？

sentences.en: So that was actually one of the strong recommendations in the report, which was that there be some kind of
sentences.zh: 这实际上是报告中的一项重要建议，即应该组建某种

sentences.en: coalition formed that is part of the decision-making process that draws from a variety of stakeholders in the community.
sentences.zh: 联盟，作为决策过程的一部分，从社区的各种利益相关者中汲取意见。

sentences.en: Of course, key are leaders in education and leaders in public health and with knowledge of infectious disease.
sentences.zh: 当然，关键是教育界的领导者和公共卫生及传染病知识领域的领导者。

sentences.en: These decisions are incredibly complex.
sentences.zh: 这些决定极其复杂。

sentences.en: And as I mentioned, they require the weighing of risks that require expertise in public health and epidemiology,
sentences.zh: 正如我提到的，它们需要权衡风险，这需要公共卫生和流行病学的专业知识，

sentences.en: as well as expertise in education, it's unlikely that lives in one person, right?
sentences.zh: 以及教育方面的专业知识，这不太可能由一个人承担，对吧？

sentences.en: Or even one set of people in the school.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至学校里的一组人。

sentences.en: In addition, you want the community represented, the school staff, the parents, potentially community leaders, business leaders, and creating some kind of coalition or task force.
sentences.zh: 此外，你希望社区有代表，学校教职员工、家长、潜在的社区领袖、商业领袖，并创建一个某种联盟或工作组。

sentences.en: And then being very clear on what those thresholds are.
sentences.zh: 然后非常清楚这些阈值是什么。

sentences.en: So even though the committee didn't necessarily say the thresholds, it's very helpful to a community, if some kind of coalition
sentences.zh: 所以即使委员会不一定设定了阈值，如果某种联盟能非常清楚地说明，

sentences.en: can make it very clear, here's what we'll be looking for to decide whether schools need to close again,
sentences.zh: 我们将寻找什么来决定学校是否需要再次关闭，这对社区非常有帮助，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Here's what our thresholds are going to be.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的阈值。

sentences.en: Or if we decide to only start with K-2, we're going to do a cautious opening and just serve the youngest children.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我们决定只从幼儿园到二年级开始，我们将进行谨慎的开放，只服务于最年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: Here's what it might need to look like if it looks like things are kind of in the green, and we might open up more.
sentences.zh: 如果情况看起来处于绿色区域，我们可能会开放更多，那看起来会是什么样子？

sentences.en: That just needs to be very clear for a community so that they're understanding and can see how the data are,
sentences.zh: 这对于社区来说需要非常清楚，这样他们才能理解并看到数据是如何

sentences.en: you know, indicating what decisions should be made.
sentences.zh: 表明应该做出什么决定的。

sentences.en: But the committee absolutely thinks it's an iterative process, because as we've already seen, you can get flare-ups on different locations,
sentences.zh: 但委员会绝对认为这是一个迭代的过程，因为正如我们已经看到的，你可能会在不同的地点出现疫情爆发，

sentences.en: and there's this really challenging calculus of we want to open up, you know, as we can.
sentences.zh: 而且这里有一个非常具有挑战性的计算，即我们想在可能的情况下开放，你知道。

sentences.en: But sometimes that opening up is going to mean you see a flare, and you just want to know how you're going to respond to the changing rates.
sentences.zh: 但有时这种开放意味着你会看到疫情爆发，你只是想知道你将如何应对不断变化的比率。

sentences.en: So you've offered some tips for parents in deciding whether to send their children back to in-person school or not.
sentences.zh: 所以你为家长们提供了一些关于是否送孩子回学校进行面对面学习的建议。

sentences.en: What's your advice for administrators and school officials for their decision?
sentences.zh: 你对行政人员和学校官员的决定有什么建议？

sentences.en: They're struggling, and they don't have a lot of time to make up their minds or to put in place some of the changes that they might need that are suggested in this report.
sentences.zh: 他们正在挣扎，没有太多时间来下定决心或落实本报告中建议的一些他们可能需要的改变。

sentences.en: How can they move forward expeditiously but smartly?
sentences.zh: 他们如何才能既迅速又明智地前进？

sentences.en: We emphasize, the committee emphasizes in the recommendations to really make sure there's a
sentences.zh: 我们强调，委员会在建议中强调要真正确保与该地区的公共卫生专家建立

sentences.en: partnership with the public health experts in the area so that the decision is informed by the best advice from public health.
sentences.zh: 伙伴关系，以便决策能得到公共卫生部门最佳建议的指导。

sentences.en: And we actually direct states to make sure that all districts have access to the public health expertise.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上指示各州确保所有学区都能获得公共卫生专业知识。

sentences.en: You might imagine there are some areas like Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，像华盛顿特区

sentences.en: or Boston or San
sentences.zh: 或波士顿或旧

sentences.en: Francisco with lots of institutions in the area with a concentration of public health experts, as well as the local public health offices, which often are going to be very strong.
sentences.zh: 金山这样有很多机构的地区，聚集了公共卫生专家，以及通常非常强大的地方公共卫生办公室。

sentences.en: But there's other parts of the country where the public health offices in rural areas, especially, haven't been well-funded.
sentences.zh: 但在这个国家的其他地方，特别是在农村地区，公共卫生办公室并没有得到很好的资助。

sentences.en: And there may not be that kind of expertise.
sentences.zh: 可能没有那种专业知识。

sentences.en: And we direct states to make sure that districts have access to that.
sentences.zh: 我们指示各州确保学区能获得这些知识。

sentences.en: So that one would be quickly get the input from the public health and infectious disease
sentences.zh: 所以第一点是迅速从公共卫生和传染病

sentences.en: specialists so that you're making these decisions in a way that's informed by knowledge of the nature of community spread.
sentences.zh: 专家那里获得意见，这样你在做出这些决定时，能了解社区传播的性质。

sentences.en: And also, they could look at the mitigation strategies that you're considering and provide some advice on.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们可以查看你正在考虑的缓解策略并提供一些建议。

sentences.en: If this is the way you're thinking of implementing physical distancing in your school, does this make sense?
sentences.zh: 如果这是你考虑在学校实施物理距离的方式，这有意义吗？

sentences.en: Is this going to work based on what an infectious disease specialist sort of has to say about transmission?
sentences.zh: 根据传染病专家对传播的看法，这行得通吗？

sentences.en: Looking at our recommendations about
sentences.zh: 看看我们关于

sentences.en: the suite of mitigation strategies that need to be implemented, putting the greatest weight on the
sentences.zh: 需要实施的一系列缓解策略的建议，将最大的权重放在

sentences.en: set that are identified in the recommendation, there is one set of practices that the CDC does call for,
sentences.zh: 建议中确定的那一套上，有一套做法是CDC确实要求的，

sentences.en: but there seem to be mixed evidence about its sort of practicality and return on investment.
sentences.zh: 但关于其实用性和投资回报率似乎存在混合的证据。

sentences.en: And that's the temperature screening and symptom screening, which adds a huge layer of practical challenge to bringing people into the school each morning.
sentences.zh: 那就是体温筛查和症状筛查，这给每天早上让人们进入学校增加了巨大的实际挑战。

sentences.en: And it's just not clear from the evidence what the return is on doing that, especially as it becomes more clear that there's asymptomatic transmission,
sentences.zh: 而且从证据中并不清楚这样做有什么回报，特别是当无症状传播变得越来越明显时，

sentences.en: which means that there could be people coming into the school without fevers, with minimal symptoms who are contagious.
sentences.zh: 这意味着可能会有人在没有发烧、症状轻微的情况下进入学校，但他们具有传染性。

sentences.en: And so definitely making sure families understand, keep kids home, if they're showing any signs or if you strongly suspect there's been exposure in your family, better to keep
sentences.zh: 所以一定要确保家庭理解，如果孩子表现出任何迹象，或者你强烈怀疑你的家庭有接触史，最好让

sentences.en: kids home.
sentences.zh: 孩子待在家里。

sentences.en: Similarly, creating policies so that staff can feel okay about staying home if they are feeling sick or know there's been an exposure.
sentences.zh: 同样，制定政策，让员工在感到不适或知道有接触史时，可以放心地待在家里。

sentences.en: So we have some discussion in our chapter five where we discuss the mitigation strategies also about the idea that creating a culture where there's sort of everyone is
sentences.zh: 所以我们在第五章中讨论了缓解策略，也讨论了这样一种想法，即创造一种文化，每个人都

sentences.en: committed to collectively protecting each other's health as part of what's important to set in a school as well.
sentences.zh: 致力于共同保护彼此的健康，这也是学校中需要确立的重要内容。

sentences.en: So you have the procedures, but then creating ways where everyone understands them, understands why they're doing them.
sentences.zh: 所以你有程序，但也要创造一种方式，让每个人都理解它们，理解为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: And sort of, it's a mutual respect in and trying to keep each other safe in a positive way.
sentences.zh: 这是一种相互尊重，并以积极的方式努力保持彼此安全。

sentences.en: You know, including policies around, you know, you don't get the award for perfect attendance during a pandemic because that's not actually going to send the signal that you want.
sentences.zh: 你知道，包括围绕这些的政策，你知道，在疫情期间你不会因为全勤而获得奖励，因为那实际上并不会发出你想要的信号。

sentences.en: Good point.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: Good point.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: Well, this has been really interesting, Dr. Schwein-Gruber.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的很有趣，Schwein-Gruber博士。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your taking the time to talk to us today.
sentences.zh: 我非常感谢你今天抽出时间与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.zh: 谢谢。
